summary: Quote mode, then a deliberate close of the broadcast socket: the feed sends the logout text frame the web's client sends before it closes, then the close, and does not reconnect.

notes: The web publishes every subscription from its packet stores every 500 ms (motilal_adapter.py _poll_market_data); web.json holds the poll after each push, the desktop sends a frame when a packet changes what a subscription reports.

motilal_websocket.py:274-280, the web's own comment on this frame: "UNVERIFIED FRAME: this JSON is copied from doc 34-trade-websocket.md, which describes the *trade* socket (wss://openapi.motilaloswal.com/ws). The broadcast feed here is a different, binary transport and the docs define no logout frame for it, so the server may well ignore this. It is harmless (we close the socket immediately after) and is kept only because nothing better is documented." The desktop sends it as the web does (lead 2026-11-09); what the broadcast server does with it is for the maintainer's live check.
